name: milana-erp
description: Safe Milana ERP GM assistant tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Provides controlled read-only ERP tools and confirmation-gated notification/task actions through the Milana ERP backend. The extension reads the ERP token already configured on this computer and does not bundle credentials.

tools.name: erp_me
tools.description: Return the current authenticated ERP user, role, department, and permissions.

tools.name: erp_gm_summary
tools.description: Return the management dashboard summary for the authenticated GM user.

tools.name: erp_search
tools.description: Search safe ERP entities through the existing global search endpoint.

tools.name: erp_active_production
tools.description: Return active production status from the ERP dashboard endpoint.

tools.name: erp_late_orders
tools.description: Return late active orders by filtering active production dashboard data.

tools.name: erp_inventory_status
tools.description: Return the GM-facing inventory dashboard summary.

tools.name: erp_finance_summary
tools.description: Return the finance dashboard summary if the ERP user has finance permission.

tools.name: erp_list_employee_tasks
tools.description: List employee tasks through the ERP task API with safe filtering.

tools.name: erp_send_notification
tools.description: Preview or send a confirmed ERP notification to a controlled target.

tools.name: erp_create_task
tools.description: Preview or create a confirmed ERP task through the existing task API.
